purpose: Whole-project clean rebuild of the Lean project of release v1.26.0 (adds Papers 28 to 31).
result: 4046 of 4046 modules compiled; 4045 of 4046 replayed with leanchecker; the module Research has no constants and was exempted; 0 audit problems. One pass.
computer: the author's Windows computer (63 GB of memory, 16 logical CPUs). According to a recursive file listing taken after the rebuild (evidence kept with the release work files), no file in the directories of OpenAI Codex there (.codex, ai4math-codex*, ai4math-lean-worker) was written or created during the rebuild; the newest file in them is from 2026-11-20 18:44:07 UTC.
procedure: New empty output directory; the sources were the release tree lean/ of this version (Research.lean and Research/, 4046 Lean modules and two Python generator scripts that are not built). After the rebuild the SHA-256 hashes of all 4048 files of the source directory were compared with the release tree: no difference. The directory Comparator/ was not built here; it is unchanged since version 1.13.0, and the CI workflow checks it.
Each module compiled with lean -DautoImplicit=false -DrelaxedAutoImplicit=false, then each module replayed with leanchecker, by the driver build6.py of version 1.16.0. This is not a lake build.

Warnings are recorded and do not fail a module; an error, sorry or non-zero exit code does. The driver reruns a module automatically (up to five times) when an attempt ends in a memory or file-read failure rather than a Lean verdict. It starts a new Lean process only while enough commit charge (memory reserved by Windows) is free.

In the published logs the local workspace directory is replaced by <workspace> (no other local directory occurs in them), Windows line endings of status.json, plan.json, research-olean-constants.txt and run.log are written as Unix line endings, and the byte-order mark at the start of research-olean-constants.txt is removed; nothing else is changed. run.log is empty: the driver writes its progress to status.json.
